The immutable Hub package is the public Hub SDK and CLI packed (`npm pack`) from AgentOrg main at `15095614bf09086a476930eafa764dbc15bf45cb`: the Report level, [AgentOrg PRs 62–65](https://github.com/uniac-ai/AgentOrg/pull/65). The authoritative Tool descriptions are used without a local override.

`agentorg-cli-1509561.tgz` has SHA256 `6b17567dcb5505b37ad7856f16fb457d225c2dd98363672f266aac4b239b2aad`. Production imports only its public `@agentorg/cli/contract` schemas/types. Tests additionally launch its public `agentorg-server` command against an owned temporary home and use exported Actor APIs. No sibling checkout or private server/storage imports are used.

The Hub bundles Workspace 0.5.0, source `cda95eb`: undirected asks, approvals answered only by the asker's managers, each Actor's status, Work with a title and steps, and Messages in their pair's conversation. The full Hub catalog has 11 Tools and 30 interfaces, each tagged with its level; 12 are at the Report level. Test fixtures always use new empty homes.
